original_test_intent: Verify that F12 at POST reaches the approved network-boot path and boots the identified host from a controlled, non-destructive network image while POST values remain correct.
original_method: Bind host/console, expected POST values and authorized NIC/target/image; isolate and validate the PXE/DHCP/TFTP/HTTP path, approve reboot and network boot, have the operator press F12 and select only the approved target, collect visual and server-side boot proof, then stop without installation and recover normally.
manual_activity: Operator presses F12 at the target prompt, chooses only the approved network entry, confirms pre-OS values and observes the test image start/stop; automation may provide PXE and network evidence.
required_inputs: Expected BIOS version/date and network menu target
Exact non-destructive image/hash and boot-success oracle
safety_requirements: Prevent unattended installation or disk changes
Press only F12 and select only approved target
Stop on wrong image/target or change
No auto-retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Verify identities and network service configuration
Report without claiming manual action or final verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects ordinary SSH as a substitute for F12, but omits the network boot service and machine-verifiable transfer/session evidence required by the source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an operator for F12/approved target selection and an isolated PXE service for a hash-pinned non-destructive image; collect complete visual and server-side evidence and stop without install.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: F12, POST values, network boot and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Pair continuous POST/F12 capture with DHCP/PXE/image-hash/session logs and an explicit non-persistent success marker.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds network provenance and no-install guardrails.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Completes actual network boot rather than stopping at menu entry.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong target or image can boot untrusted code or start destructive provisioning.

project_override_considerations: Project must approve the exact isolated server, NIC/boot entry, image/hash and non-destructive stop point; an ordinary production PXE installer is not acceptable.
expected_evidence: Expected POST values and F12/menu capture

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require F12-triggered network boot plus correct POST information.
